purpose: Research-only qualification of ESC flight phase and high-frequency U/V structure. Not an Analysis operator. Not a production filter.
dropPolicy: I1 isUsableWindRecord: drop missing U or V (9999), Qu/Qv MISSING(9) or BAD(3), missing Alt (99999). Native order preserved. Heights must be strictly increasing after drop.

pendulumLengthTable.note: plausible radiosonde train length, not a VORTEX2 measured length
Dirksen et al. 2014 mention ~30 m RS92 unwinder in a ventilation estimate

mooreControl.note: IGRA operational/coarse control. No ESC 1-s TIME. Do not apply RS92/Aspen assumptions. Absence of hodograph hair is not evidence of absence of pendulation; high-frequency content is unresolved.
mooreControl.nyquist: no uniform 1-s series; periods near 10 s are not observable

identity.comments: M Parker/tornado formed approx 30 min after launch, Good Sounding

method.retainedDtCheck: exact 1 s share of consecutive I1-retained TIME steps
method.fft: Hann-windowed periodogram of research-only series; dt = 1 s
method.interpolation: linear interpolation of U/V onto integer-second grid spanning first..last kept TIME, solely for spectral diagnostics; never written back
method.firstDifferences: only consecutive retained pairs with Δt exactly 1 s; no interpolation
backgrounds: residual after centered 31-s moving average (~30 s)
residual after centered 61-s moving average (~60 s)
method.welch: 256 s windows, 50% overlap, 30 s MA residual
method.windowedPersistence: 256 s windows, 50% overlap, 6–20 s band peak tracking
